# @appfigures/agent-toolkit

> App-store intelligence for AI agents — download and revenue estimates, reviews, ranks,
> keywords, ads, and audience for any app on any major store. Ships as tools (Vercel AI SDK,
> OpenAI, LangChain) and a typed SDK client.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): install, the four surfaces, per-framework wiring, the write gate, configuration
- [API reference](./docs/api-reference.md): every action with parameters, types, and examples
- [Client API](./docs/client-api.md): the typed `AppfiguresAgentClient`, for when your agent writes code — calling actions, returned data, errors, hints, authentication
- [Tools API](./docs/tools-api.md): the action surface and framework adapters, for when your agent calls tools in a framework — the write gate, results, scoping, per-request auth
- [Recipes](./docs/recipes.md): real multi-step flows (competitor teardown, ASO research, review triage)

## Reference

- [Catalog playbook](./docs/catalog_playbook.md): the `explorer` query grammar and field list
- [Numeric metrics](./docs/numeric_metrics.md): the datasets `metrics.query` accepts
- [Glossary](./docs/glossary.md): domain terms
